title: Tiger cub with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='24' r='13' fill='#f5a623'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='24' r='13' fill='#f5a623'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='24' r='7' fill='#ff9db5'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='24' r='7' fill='#ff9db5'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='34' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <!-- cheek fluff -->
  <polygon points='18,42 8,52 20,56' fill='#ffcf70'/>
  <polygon points='82,42 92,52 80,56' fill='#ffcf70'/>
  <!-- forehead stripes -->
  <rect x='44' y='18' width='4' height='12' rx='2' fill='#b35c00'/>
  <rect x='52' y='18' width='4' height='12' rx='2' fill='#b35c00'/>
  <rect x='35' y='24' width='4' height='10' rx='2' transform='rotate(-20 37 29)' fill='#b35c00'/>
  <rect x='61' y='24' width='4' height='10' rx='2' transform='rotate(20 63 29)' fill='#b35c00'/>
  <!-- side stripes -->
  <rect x='20' y='48' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b35c00'/>
  <rect x='19' y='56' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b35c00'/>
  <rect x='71' y='48' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b35c00'/>
  <rect x='73' y='56' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b35c00'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='17' ry='12' fill='#fff3d6'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ff9db5'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='56' rx='2' ry='1.2' fill='#ffd6e0'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 61 Q46 66 42 64' stroke='#b35c00' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 61 Q54 66 58 64' stroke='#b35c00' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes white -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='44' rx='9' ry='10' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='44' rx='9' ry='10' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- irises -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='45' r='6' fill='#3a7d44'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='45' r='6' fill='#3a7d44'/>
  <!-- pupils -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='45' r='3.5' fill='#1a3d24'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='45' r='3.5' fill='#1a3d24'/>
  <!-- sparkles in eyes -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='42' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='42' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='48' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='48' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- eye shine dots -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='41' r='1' fill='#eaffea'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='41' r='1' fill='#eaffea'/>
  <!-- whisker dots -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='60' r='1.2' fill='#d4872a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='63' r='1.2' fill='#d4872a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='63' r='1.2' fill='#d4872a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='60' r='1.2' fill='#d4872a'/>
</svg>
